status: frozen independent reference; not product output, not a qualification or acceptance claim
basis: exact arithmetic over Q(pi) (rational functions of pi); decimals and binary64 values are rounded from the exact forms; mill tolerance = corrosion allowance = 0 and every non-axial response is zero, so the values are section-basis and shear-model neutral
independence: generators/u5a_reference.py imports no product code and reads only its own fixture
physics_source: JR CONTRACT.md sections 2, 4, 6 and its independent refutation sections 2-3 (archived at 11718e61a2^); re-derived here from the axial free bodies

criterion.rule: an entry passes when |obs - exp| <= 1e-9 * max(|exp|, F), F the floor of its family; both solver modes

sign_conventions.axial: scalars along the chain axis n (axis_global) from A towards D; q = (u_j - u_i) . Q_x
sign_conventions.Tb: joint elastic tensile force g_x = k (q - q_ref)
sign_conventions.Pe: joint pressure generalized force p Ae, conjugate to qt_x (dead load, reference geometry)
sign_conventions.S_joint: effective axial force Tb + Tt - Pe with Tt = 0 (untied)
sign_conventions.Nw: pipe wall tension EA(eps - eps_T) + 2 nu Pi (pressurized members)
sign_conventions.S_pipe: Nw - Pi on a pressurized member
sign_conventions.reactions: support on model, R = K u - f
sign_conventions.pressure_rhs: the pressure-only RHS (caps, Poisson pairs, joint terms); thermal and q_ref loads are not pressure terms

J3-1.interface_identity: S_pipe = S_joint at both joint faces (checked exactly)

lateral_offset_demonstration.meaning: with equal lateral offsets 0.01 m the full joint pair p Ae carries end moments of magnitude 0.01 m x p Ae = 8 N*m about z, which the adjacent pipes' centreline face caps do not cancel; a nodal p(Ae - Ai) pair would drop them, so U5a refuses nonzero attachment offsets on a pressurized joint
